'''Taoska''' was the fifth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tyrius/Legends|Tyrius]] in the [[Tyrius system/Legends|Tyrius system]],<ref name="SE" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Taoska had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was an [[Water/Legends|ice]] ball<ref name="SE" /><ref name="EA" /> that remained inhospitable to [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], the native [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Rodia/Legends|only habitable planet]] in the Tyrius system. A small, bright light from Taoska was visible in the sky of the Rodians' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="SE" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Tyrius system/Legends|Tyrius system]], except [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], were first introduced in the [[1996]] sourcebook ''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''.<ref name="SE" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Tyrius star system in grid square R-16.<ref name="EA" />
